page.title: Rules
page.subtitle: Fill in tags, categories and payees automatically when a transaction is created or imported

page.subtitle: Choose when the rule runs, which transactions it matches and what it changes

when.description: Choose when the rule looks at a transaction
when.atLeastOne: Keep at least one option selected
when.stopProcessingHelp: When this rule matches a transaction, the rules after it in the list are skipped for that transaction.

window.title: Active between
window.help: The rule only applies to transactions dated inside this window, when they are created or imported and when the rule is tested or run. Leave a date empty for no limit.
window.backwards: The last date must not be before the first date
window.words: Only for transactions dated from {from} to {to}

if.description: The actions run only for transactions that match
if.everyTransaction: No conditions yet, so this rule applies to every transaction.

then.empty: No actions yet. Add at least one.
then.limit: A rule can have at most {max} actions.

group.notLabel: Negate this group: it matches when its conditions do not
group.title: Group
group.depthLimit: Groups can be nested at most {max} levels deep.
group.sizeLimit: The condition limit has been reached.

value.matchesHint: Use * for any text, for example *coffee*. A pattern without * matches only the whole text. Use {capture} to keep the text at that spot for the actions of this rule, for example {example}. A name is lowercase letters and digits, and a pattern can keep up to {max} texts.

action.title: Action
action.instructionPlaceholder: For example, split this purchase by the receipt
action.instructionHelp: The rule only asks for a review. A person approves any change before it is made.
action.onlyIfEmptyHelp: When on, the rule fills in the category or payee only if the transaction has none. It does not replace one set by hand or by the payee's default category. Turn it off to replace it.
action.templateHelp: Plain text. Each placeholder in braces is replaced with text from the transaction. Select a placeholder below to insert it.
action.joinHelp: The text is joined to the current description exactly as written, so include any space or separator you want.
action.placeholdersHelp: {payeeText} is the payee text as received. {description} is the description as it stands when this action runs. The other placeholders are the captures named in the patterns of this rule.
action.unknownPlaceholders: Not defined by this rule: {names}. Choose a placeholder from the list, or capture it in a pattern above.
action.invalidPlaceholders: Not a valid placeholder: {names}. A name is lowercase letters and digits.
action.createIfMissing: Create the payee if it does not exist
action.createIfMissingHelp: When on, and no payee matches the name (by name, alias or a close match), a new payee is created with it. A payee created by a rule is kept if you undo the run.
action.onlyIfEmptyDescriptionHelp: When on, the rule writes the description only if the transaction has none. Turn it off to write it every time.
action.convertHelp: The matched income or expense becomes one leg of a transfer. The other leg is created in the account you choose, which must use the same currency.
action.directionTo: Expense: the money goes to another account
action.directionFrom: Income: the money comes from another account
action.clearCategoryHelp: A transfer has no category. Turn this off to keep the category the transaction already has.
action.splitHint: Each part takes its amount from a capture in the patterns above, or takes the rest. The parts must add up to the amount of the transaction, otherwise the rule leaves it alone.
action.splitNoCaptures: No capture is defined yet. Put a name in braces in a pattern above, for example PRINCIPAL: {example}, to use it as an amount here.
action.partsLimit: A split can have at most {max} parts.
action.splitGuideHow: In “If”, add a condition on the payee text or description with the operator “matches the pattern”, and put names in curly braces where the amounts are, for example {first}. Each name becomes an amount you can pick for a part, or choose “The rest”. The parts must add up to the transaction amount, otherwise the rule leaves the transaction unchanged. A part can be a category or a transfer to another account (a transfer moves the balance of that account).
action.splitGuidePart1: Part 1: {first} as a transfer to the loan account
action.splitGuideResult: Result for -1500,75: -1200,50 transferred to the loan account and -300,25 of interest expense.
action.splitGuideTip: Tip: set a start date under “Active between” so older reconciled transactions are not changed, and use the Test panel before saving.
action.convertGuide: An expense becomes a transfer to the account you choose, and an income becomes a transfer from it. Only the balance of the other account changes. Tip: use “Active between” so older transactions are not changed.

save.summary: The rule was not saved. Fix the items marked below and try again.

loadError.title: The rule could not be loaded
loadError.body: Nothing is shown because the request failed, not because the rule is empty. Check your connection and try again.
loadError.lookupsBody: The lists of accounts, payees, categories, tags and currencies could not be loaded, so the rule cannot be shown safely. Check your connection and try again.
loadError.notFound: This rule no longer exists. It may have been deleted.

invalid.title: This rule cannot run
invalid.repaired: Some parts of the saved definition could not be read and were removed or reset here. Review the rule before saving.

conflict.title: This rule was changed elsewhere
conflict.body: Reload it to see the latest version. Your unsaved edits will be lost.

codes.INVALID_SHAPE: This part is not in a form the editor understands.
codes.UNKNOWN_KEY: This part has a setting that does not exist.
codes.OPERATOR_NOT_ALLOWED: This field does not allow that operator.
codes.VALUE_TYPE: The value is of the wrong kind for this field.
codes.VALUE_OUT_OF_RANGE: The value is out of range.
codes.INVALID_UUID: Choose an item from the list.
codes.INVALID_ENUM: Choose one of the listed values.
codes.RANGE_ORDER: The first value must not be greater than the second.
codes.MAX_DEPTH: Groups are nested too deeply. The limit is {maxDepth} levels.
codes.MAX_LEAVES: There are too many conditions. The limit is {maxLeaves}.
codes.MAX_NODES: There are too many conditions and groups. The limit is {maxNodes}.
codes.TOO_MANY_ACTIONS: There are too many actions. The limit is {maxActions}.
codes.DUPLICATE_ACTION: A rule can have only one AI review, one transfer or split, and one split part that takes the rest.
codes.CONFLICTING_ACTIONS: A transfer or split action cannot be combined with “Set the category”, and each of its parts has either a category or an account.
codes.INVALID_CAPTURE: A capture name must be lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter, and up to 20 long.
codes.TOO_MANY_CAPTURES: A pattern can hold at most 5 captures.
codes.DUPLICATE_CAPTURE: Each capture name can be used once in a rule.
codes.UNKNOWN_CAPTURE: This uses a capture that no condition of this rule defines.
codes.LOOKS_LIKE_REGEX: Regular expressions are not supported: | \ and short bracket classes like [xy] are matched as plain characters, so a pattern written as a regex never matches what was meant. To match one of several texts, add a group of “Any of these” and put one condition in it for each text.
codes.PATTERN_WITHOUT_WILDCARD: Without a * this pattern must equal the whole text. Use the operator “is” for the whole text, “contains” for a part of it, or put * around the text, for example *coffee*.
codes.REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND: An item chosen here no longer exists. Choose another.
codes.NAME_REQUIRED: Enter a name for the rule.

run.saveFirst: Save your changes to run the saved rule.

expression.label: Condition expression
expression.help: Write the conditions as text. Use && for all of these, || for any of these and !( ... ) for not. Refer to items by name: account("Name"), payee("Name"), category("Parent: Child") and tag("Name"). An underscore _ stands for a value you have not chosen yet. matchesGlob uses * as a wildcard. Only the syntax offered in the suggestions is supported.
expression.blocked: Fix the expression to switch back to Visual or to save.

errors.tooLong: The expression is too long. The limit is {max} characters.
errors.unterminatedString: This text has no closing quote.
errors.invalidEscape: This escape sequence is not supported.
errors.badNumber: This is not a valid number.
errors.expectedField: A field name is expected here.
errors.expectedOperator: An operator or a method is expected after the field.
errors.unsupported: This part is not supported. Use only the syntax offered in the suggestions.
errors.operatorNotAllowed: The field {field} cannot be used with {operator}.
errors.wrongValueType: {expected, select, text {Expected text in quotes.} number {Expected a number.} boolean {Expected true or false.} list {Expected a list in square brackets.} account {Expected an account, for example account("Name").} payee {Expected a payee, for example payee("Name").} category {Expected a category, for example category("Parent: Child").} tag {Expected a tag, for example tag("Name").} other {This value is of the wrong kind.}}
errors.invalidCurrency: Use a three letter currency code in quotes, for example "CAD".
errors.valueTooLong: The text is too long. The limit is {max} characters.
errors.listTooLong: The list is too long. The limit is {max} items.
errors.unknownEntity: {kind, select, account {No account is named {name}.} payee {No payee is named {name}.} category {No category is named {name}.} tag {No tag is named {name}.} other {No item is named {name}.}}
errors.ambiguousEntity: {count} items are named {name}. Add the number of the one you mean, for example {example}.
errors.entityOrdinal: The number for {name} must be from 1 to {count}.
errors.maxDepth: Groups are nested too deeply. The limit is {max} levels.
errors.maxLeaves: There are too many conditions. The limit is {max}.
errors.maxNodes: There are too many conditions and groups. The limit is {max}.

test.title: Test
test.description: Try the rule on your existing transactions. Nothing is changed.
test.incomplete: Complete the conditions and actions above to test the rule.
test.idle: Choose which transactions to try the rule on, then select Test rule.
test.failed: The test could not be completed. {message}
test.stale: The rule or the filters changed since this result. Test again to see the current result.

run.title: Run "{name}" on existing transactions
run.description: Preview what the rule would change, then confirm. You can undo the run from the action history.
run.idle: Choose accounts and dates, then select Preview. Nothing changes until you confirm.
run.previewFailed: The preview could not be loaded, so nothing can be run. {message}
run.stale: The filters changed since this preview. Preview again before you run.
run.accountsFailed: Your accounts could not be loaded, so the filters are unavailable.
run.summary: {matched, plural, one {# transaction would change} other {# transactions would change}} out of {scanned, plural, one {# transaction} other {# transactions}} scanned.
run.matchesNone: This rule matches none of the transactions examined ({scanned}). Check the conditions before saving. A pattern without * matches only the whole text.
run.noChange: {matched} of the {scanned} transactions examined match the rule's conditions, but nothing would change (for example, they already have the value and only-if-empty is on). This is not an error.
run.truncated: More transactions matched than the limit allows. Only the newest are included. Raise the limit or narrow the dates to include the rest.

noMatches.title: No transactions would change
noMatches.body: None of the scanned transactions match the rule, or the rule would change nothing on them.

skipped.title: {count, plural, one {# transaction is left alone} other {# transactions are left alone}}

skipReasons.transfer_leg_category: it is a transfer, which has no category
skipReasons.split_category: it is split, so the category belongs to the splits
skipReasons.cross_owner_transfer_payee: it is a transfer to another owner, whose payee this rule may not change
skipReasons.empty_render: the text of an action came out empty for it
skipReasons.payee_not_found: no payee has the name the rule built, and it does not create one
skipReasons.transfer_direction_mismatch: the transfer goes the wrong way for it: an expense goes to an account, an income comes from one
skipReasons.transfer_same_account: the transfer account is the account of the transaction itself
skipReasons.transfer_account_unavailable: the transfer account is not available (it was deleted or is not yours)
skipReasons.transfer_currency_mismatch: the transfer account uses another currency
skipReasons.split_amount_unparseable: an amount in its text could not be read as a number
skipReasons.split_sum_mismatch: the parts do not add up to its amount
skipReasons.split_too_few_parts: fewer than two parts are left once zero amounts are dropped
